title: Bitcoin fills new year CME gap with sub-$88K BTC price dip
summary: Bitcoin hit a key BTC price target from the start of January, with other CME futures gaps now above price, but traders remained cautious.

title: New SEC submissions press on self-custody and DeFi regulation
summary: The submissions add to mounting pressure on regulators as Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong calls for compromise to pass market structure legislation.

title: Solana Mobile launches SKR token airdrop for Seeker phone users
summary: Solana Mobile's airdrop of almost 2 billion SKR tokens for 100,000 Seeker users is claimable for 90 days, with staking rewards starting immediately.

title: Aave refocuses on DeFi, hands Lens stewardship to Mask Network
summary: Mask Network will lead consumer-facing product execution on Lens, while Aave steps back to an advisory role focused on protocol infrastructure.

title: Nansen launches AI crypto trading tools on Base, Solana
summary: The new AI-powered crypto trading platforms are aimed at replacing traditional trading charts and order books with trading execution offered through natural language processing.

title: Galaxy to launch $100M hedge fund to bet on rising, falling crypto prices
summary: Galaxy plans to deploy a new hedge fund strategy that targets both crypto tokens and traditional financial stocks as the “up-only” phase fades.

title: Bhutan to deploy Sei validator in Q1, eyes tokenization collab
summary: Bhutan is adding to its growing list of blockchain initiatives. It already runs a Bitcoin mining operation and also launched a self-sovereign ID system powered by Ethereum.

title: Grayscale files to convert NEAR Protocol Trust into ETF on NYSE Arca
summary: Grayscale continued its pattern of trust-to-ETF conversions with the NEAR Trust despite declining fund performance.

title: Trump’s crypto advisor calls for compromises to pass crypto bill
summary: As Republicans look to notch policy wins ahead of the midterms, Trump advisor Patrick Witt says the market structure bill must include compromises to advance in the Senate.

title: Bitcoin search, social chatter slumped in 2025 despite record prices
summary: Bitcoiner Jameson Lopp shared data on Tuesday showing that the number of X posts containing the word “Bitcoin” fell by around a third in 2025 compared to 2024.
